t.zh: 这三个人，<level-ref to="e-three"></level-ref>里接成电路跑遍了八行，<level-ref to="kk-three"></level-ref>里亲手证过。这一次交给证明助手。
t.en: These three were wired as a circuit and run on all eight rows in <level-ref to="e-three"></level-ref>, and proved by hand in <level-ref to="kk-three"></level-ref>. This time, hand them to the proof assistant.

brief.zh: a 说：「b 是无赖。」b 说：「c 是无赖。」c 说：「a 和 b 都是无赖。」设计一个证明助手，证出每个人的身份。
brief.en: a says: “b is a knave.” b says: “c is a knave.” c says: “a and b are both knaves.” Design a proof assistant that proves what each of them is.
